title: OpenCode (default)
description: OpenCode on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: OpenCode (Standard)
de.description: OpenCode an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur sein Modell ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: opencode.ai (OpenCode Zen; your login: sandbox-ai login opencode once); its hosts are open by default, nothing else of the provider's. A server of yours instead: the preset opencode-local-llm.
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-opencode or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
